english.title: Cause use of a motor vehicle with an insecure load - non endorsable offence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on which was carried a load which was

(C)_[so secured]_
(D)_[in such a position]_

that danger or nuisance was likely to be caused to any person or property by reason of

(E)_[the load or any part thereof falling or being blown from it]_
(F)_[any movement of the load or any part thereof in relation to it]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) OFFICERS SHOULD BE AWARE that this is a non-endorsable offence - a comparable endorsable offence exists under section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 which should be used wherever possible.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Information may be added to the Statement of Facts giving details of any actual damage caused.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
